description: Composite four-panel TEM figure (panels outlined by coloured dashed boxes) of the 17Al alloy aged at 575 °C for 6 h, mixing bright-field (BF) micrographs, EDS elemental maps, SAED patterns and HRTEM images. (a) Two low-magnification BF images (1 μm scale bars) showing many fine bright particles decorating the interfaces between large grains. (b) A BF image (500 nm) of an elongated particle with internal parallel bands plus a magnified inset of it, and four EDS maps labelled Fe (red), Mn (green), Al (cyan) and Cu (magenta), each with a 500 nm scale bar, in which Cu is concentrated in the elongated particles while Fe and Mn are depleted there; the blue-circled area yields an SAED pattern (2 nm⁻¹, [011] beam) labelled "FCC twin" with two superimposed patterns outlined in orange and blue. (c) BF micrographs (200 nm and 100 nm) of acicular particles, an SAED pattern of the boxed particle indexed to β-Mn (reflections ī0ī, ī10, 110, 0 1 1̄, 101; 2 nm⁻¹, [111] beam), and an HRTEM lattice image with its FFT inset labelled β-Mn. (d) A BF image (100 nm) of a dark rectangular particle and an HRTEM image (5 nm) across its interface, with dashed lines separating β-Mn (green label) from FCC Cu-rich (magenta label) and their respective FFT insets (5 nm⁻¹). The panels jointly show that fine FCC Cu-rich particles containing FCC twins precipitate at β-Mn interfaces.

subfigures.description: Two low-magnification bright-field TEM images side by side, each with a 1 μm scale bar, showing a coarse grain structure with numerous fine bright second-phase particles sitting along grain/interface boundaries.

High-magnification BF image (500 nm scale bar) of an elongated particle containing parallel internal bands, with a white-box magnification inset of a similar particle; to its right four EDS elemental maps labelled Fe, Mn, Al and Cu (500 nm scale bars each) showing Cu-enriched (magenta) elongated particles where Fe and Mn are depleted; below, an SAED pattern (2 nm⁻¹ scale, [011] beam) of the blue-circled region, labelled 'FCC twin', with two superimposed diffraction patterns outlined by orange and blue parallelograms.

Left: BF image (200 nm scale bar) of acicular second-phase particles, a white box around one particle linked by a green circle to its SAED pattern (2 nm⁻¹, [111] beam) indexed with hexagonal β-Mn reflections (ī0ī, ī10, 110, 0 1 1̄, 101). Bottom left: BF image (100 nm) of a lenticular particle with internal bands. Bottom right: HRTEM lattice image with green 'β-Mn' label and an FFT inset (2 nm⁻¹, [111] beam) showing a hexagonal spot array.

Left: BF image (100 nm scale bar) of a dark rectangular particle embedded in a brighter matrix. Right: HRTEM image (5 nm scale bar) of the particle/matrix interface, divided by dashed white lines, with a green arrow to an FFT inset labelled 'β-Mn' (5 nm⁻¹) and a magenta arrow to an FFT inset labelled 'FCC Cu-rich' (5 nm⁻¹), and white 'FFT' boxes marking the analysed regions.

observations.observation: Panel (a) consists of two low-magnification bright-field TEM images, each carrying a 1 μm scale bar.
In (a) many fine bright particles are distributed along the interfaces between the larger grains, indicating interfacial precipitation.

The EDS maps in (b) are labelled Fe (red), Mn (green), Al (cyan) and Cu (magenta) with 500 nm scale bars; Cu is strongly enriched in the elongated particles while Fe and Mn are depleted in the same locations, and Al appears comparatively uniform.
The SAED pattern in (b) is labelled 'FCC twin', recorded along the [011] beam with a 2 nm⁻¹ scale bar, and shows two superimposed spot patterns outlined by orange and blue parallelograms.
The SAED pattern in (c) is indexed to β-Mn with the labelled reflections ī0ī, ī10, 110, 0 1 1̄ and 101 β-Mn, recorded along the [111] beam with a 2 nm⁻¹ scale bar and a green hexagonal outline.
The HRTEM image in (c) shows an atomic-resolution lattice with an FFT inset labelled β-Mn (2 nm⁻¹, [111] beam) displaying a hexagonal arrangement of spots.
Panel (d) contrasts an FFT inset labelled 'β-Mn' (green, 5 nm⁻¹) with one labelled 'FCC Cu-rich' (magenta, 5 nm⁻¹) across dashed lines marking the interface in a 5 nm-scale HRTEM image.

The caption identifies the alloy as the 17Al alloy aged at 575 °C for 6 h and describes (a) as low-magnification BF images, (b) as a high-magnification BF image with EDS mapping and the SAED pattern of the blue-circled FCC-twin area, (c) as BF images with SAED and HRTEM of the β-Mn regions, and (d) as an HRTEM image of the Cu-rich phase/β-Mn interface.
The caption states that the SAED pattern corresponds to the area highlighted by the blue circle and is attributed to FCC twins.
The citing text reports that a large amount of fine particles were distributed at the interfaces of β-Mn in this 575 °C/6 h aged 17Al alloy.
The citing text states that EDS elemental mapping identified these interface particles as the FCC Cu-rich phase, and that an FCC twin structure was observed within the Cu-rich particles.
The citing text states that FFT analysis was performed on different regions corresponding to the β-Mn and FCC Cu-rich phases to confirm the presence of the two phases.
The citing text notes that only the FCC Cu-rich phase could be characterised by TEM here, while the BCC phase was revealed by EBSD, i.e. this figure does not evidence the BCC phase.
